claims.claim: OSM node 8266060524, tagged ref 6, locates the HUMETRO/BISCO seam or proves it is HUMETRO Exit 6.
claims.reason: The node is a third-party outdoor subway-entrance feature with no operator, mall, indoor-footpath, or shared-boundary tag. Its number cannot resolve the separate HUMETRO and BISCO exit namespaces.
